name: Respondent Lab browser workbench

schemas.runtimeValidation: Domain additionally validates Google Forms URLs, unique IDs/options, exact mappings, required answers and source scope.

commands.returns: revision, busy, status, source metadata, problems; no answer rows

commands.formUrl: HTTPS Google Forms URL; reuses configured source, identity column, purpose and criteria; clears old map

workflow: Use the official authorized browser. Open workbench and wait for the bridge.
Send source name/text, reference, purpose, Google Forms URL and optional exact idHeader/criteria in task schema rrp.agent-task.v1.
Read visible question headings, sections, kinds, required flags and exact options through the form UI. Never read hidden form payloads or use formResponse network submission.
Send observed-form schema and read status. Mapping accepts unique exact IDs or section/question labels; bare question labels only for a complete non-ambiguous form map.
Stop on missing answers, unknown kinds, ambiguous mappings or incompatible options. Ask for the missing participant facts together; do not generate answers.
Get plan. With an explicit recipient/participant/source-bound grant, fill through semantic UI controls and verify every value before Next.

Reobserve every section. Submit only within an explicit grant and an atomic durable receipt journal. Success requires visible response-recorded confirmation; unknown results must never be retried automatically.

cabinet.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <project-scoped-key>; never put keys in URLs
cabinet.permissions: read one immutable project and its linked files; no submission grant
cabinet.persistence: private Blob file catalog, independent of the legacy local SQLite; requires configured cabinet accounts/store
